summary: Microsoft offers up to $150,000 in Azure startup credits unlocked over time with verified progress, service adoption and sustained Azure usage; eligible Investor Network-backed startups may unlock up to $200,000. Neither maximum is guaranteed upfront. Applicants must own a software product/service, be privately held and for-profit, headquartered where Azure is available, not have received more than $350,000 lifetime free Azure credits, and not have raised Series C or later. Educational/government organizations, consultancies/agencies and cryptocurrency mining are excluded. Current documentation does not state a general credit duration or claim deadline. Application destination was documented but not independently completed; no award/redemption tested.
claim_steps: Apply via https://startups.microsoft.com by selecting Get started.
Confirm company-owned software product, privately held for-profit status, eligible headquarters, funding stage and prior-credit eligibility.
Eligible Investor Network-backed applicants can provide an optional investor referral code for additional benefits.
Review the actual portal allocation: credits unlock progressively with verified progress, adoption and Azure usage.
Confirm expiry and billing conditions in the award/portal rather than assuming older Founders Hub terms.
